main.remarks: Represents the internal orchestration state shared across issuance policy evaluation, assertion generation, token creation, and key construction.

property.name: Assertions
property.summary: Generated access-key assertions associated with the current issuance flow.

property.name: IssueOptions
property.summary: Normalized issuance options for the current flow.

property.name: IssuerAccessManagerID
property.summary: Access-manager identifier that will be written into the issued token.

property.name: IssuerToolID
property.summary: Tool identifier that will be written into the issued token.

property.name: Logger
property.summary: Logger available to issuance-time collaborators and derived signing contexts.

property.name: ManifestIdentity
property.summary: Current manifest identity used for issuance.

property.name: RequestContext
property.summary: Optional normalized request context when issuance originated from a request flow.

property.name: Subject
property.summary: Subject that will be bound into the issued key.

property.name: Tool
property.summary: Owning tool participating in the issuance flow.
